traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Salviniaceae: free-floating water ferns whose stems fork; leaves stalkless, in Salvinia in whorls of three, two floating and one submerged and cut into root-like threads, in Azolla alternate and two-ranked. The Library holds more Salvinia than Azolla.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 115, 117, family Salviniaceae: leaf margin entire; read as "entire".
